literalParts.primaryGround: The guide assigns both Title page and Copyright page to Publisher. It lists title/subtitle, author/editor and illustrator on the title page; the copyright page may include publisher identity, ISBN, publication date/history and printing information. The applied task is assigning production responsibility for those pages.
